events.name: Jurassic Quest – Richmond, VA | Richmond Convention Center
events.description:
The Ultimate Family Adventure!
Jurassic Quest — the world’s most popular dinosaur experience — is now the ultimate event for LEGO®  brick builders and fans.  Get ready for the ULTIMATE day of discovery, play, and imagination!
Dino Fans: Step into the age of dinosaurs and marvel at life-size, moving giants — including the towering Apatosaurus, colossal Spinosaurus, and legendary T. rex. Enjoy hands-on fossil digs, meet adorable baby dinos, and hop on thrilling dino rides.
Brick Fans: Unleash your imagination with massive LEGO-inspired sculptures, build your own designs, explore interactive play zones, and race your custom build in the wildly popular Brick Derby!
One weekend only and one ticket gets it all — grab your tickets now before they’re gone!
